mapper.insert: INSERT INTO non_users ( reconnect_token_hash, last_accessed_at ) VALUES ( #{reconnectTokenHash}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM non_users WHERE reconnect_token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participants ( event_id, non_user_id, nickname, nickname_key ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{nonUserId}, #{nickname}, #{nicknameKey} )
INSERT INTO participations ( event_id, participant_id, status ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{participantId}, 'IN_PROGRESS' )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS participantId, pt.id AS participationId, p.event_id AS eventId, p.nickname AS nickname, pt.status AS status FROM participants p INNER JOIN participations pt ON pt.participant_id = p.id AND pt.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.non_user_id = #{nonUserId}

SELECT p.id AS participantId, pt.id AS participationId, p.event_id AS eventId, p.nickname AS nickname, pt.status AS status FROM participants p INNER JOIN participations pt ON pt.participant_id = p.id AND pt.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.id = #{participantId}

SELECT pt.id AS participationId, pt.status AS status FROM participants p INNER JOIN participations pt ON pt.participant_id = p.id AND pt.event_id = p.event_id WHERE p.event_id = #{eventId} AND p.non_user_id = #{nonUserId} FOR UPDATE OF pt
mapper.update: UPDATE participations SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{participationId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
